outcome: Neonatal morbidity (1-min Apgar <= 6, advanced neonatal maneuvers, NICU admissions)
cohort: The study included full-term newborns whose mothers had at least one perinatal, neonatal, or gasometric antecedent of acute fetal distress.
finding: Newborns with a history of Acute Fetal Distress (AFD) and associated neonatal morbidity showed significantly increased umbilical cord lactate values (by 25%) and decreased pH values (by 1%) compared to those without morbidity.
cross-section timing: At birth, from umbilical cord blood samples
